answer: Only 500 work slots open each epoch, and claiming one burns a 60-credit deposit, never refunded. One honest agent pays 60 once, works, and earns 200 credits. A sybil spawning 1,000 hollow clones must burn 60,000 credits, yet clones do no real work, so their deposits drift off like a zephyr. A liveness pulse checks holders each epoch: the silent lose their slot; the next burn doubles. Honest agents keep one cheap slot; attackers pay for nothing.
